You can claim Rax from your player and team passes from previous seasons. The amount of Rax depends on how much the player or team earned on the same day in history.

The player or team pass must be **Common or better** in rarity to claim Rax.

>
You get **2** guaranteed claims per sport per day.
Go to the cards tab, and press the calendar 🗓️ button in the top right of the tab. Then select the cards you want to claim for each sport.

The total amount of Rax that a card can earn depends on the rarity level of your card. Higher rarity levels can earn more total Rax.

You can increase your card's rarity by collecting plays for that player or team in the listed season.

Pro members get a chance at **1** additional claim across all sports each day.

To claim this bonus, place your pass on a pick the winner poll in the game feed. Win the poll, and you'll receive the bonus Rax for your card. Lose, and you won’t receive bonus Rax for that card.

Look for the pass icon 🎫 below polls. Double-tap or long-press on a poll option to place your bonus pass.

Let's say you own a Rare Steph Curry 2022-23 player card. On November 15, 2022 his performance earned 18 Rax.

On November 15, 2023 you can place the card on a pick the winner poll to claim **29 Rax** (18 Rax \* 1.6 Rare multiplier). The same goes for team cards.
